ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the axis of symmetry of the parabola is the line $x=1$, and it intersects the $x$-axis at the point $A(-1,0)$. What are the coordinates of the other intersection point?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} The axis of symmetry of the parabola is the line $x=1$. Given that the coordinates of point $A$ are $(-1,0)$,\\
the symmetry of the parabola allows us to find the coordinates of the other intersection point with the $x$-axis as $\boxed{(3,0)}$.
